name: app.sleevy/mcp
title: Sleevy
description: Save links to your Sleevy library and manage your saved items and folders.

tools.name: list_saved_items
tools.title: List saved items
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved items, newest first. Results are paginated; call again with nextCursor until it is null.

tools.name: save_link
tools.title: Save link
tools.description: Save an HTTP or HTTPS link to the authenticated user's Sleevy library.

tools.name: set_saved_item_read_state
tools.title: Set saved item read state
tools.description: Mark one of the authenticated user's saved items as read or unread.

tools.name: set_saved_item_folder
tools.title: Set saved item folder
tools.description: Move a saved item to a folder, or remove it from its folder.

tools.name: delete_saved_item
tools.title: Delete saved item
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the authenticated user's saved items.

tools.name: add_folder
tools.title: Add folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the authenticated user's Sleevy library.

tools.name: remove_folder
tools.title: Remove folder
tools.description: Permanently remove one of the authenticated user's folders.
